description:
Apply the workspace extras-preservation policy (JMAP-lbdy) to crate-jmap-mail-types.

In scope (estimate ~15-20 public wire-shaped Deserialize structs):
- Email + nested: EmailAddress, EmailAddressGroup, EmailHeader, EmailBodyPart, EmailBodyValue
- Mailbox, MailboxRights / MyRights
- Thread
- Identity
- EmailSubmission, Address, DeliveryStatus, Envelope, EmailSubmissionAddress
- VacationResponse
- SearchSnippet
- MdnSendRequest, MdnSendResponse, Mdn (MDN types, #[cfg(feature="mdn")])
- SieveScript (#[cfg(feature="sieve")])

Out of scope:
- Filter / Comparator types (algebra, not server objects).
- Property selector enums (not wire structs).
- Keyword (newtype around String).
- MailboxRole, EmailSubmissionState (string enums).

Cookie-cutter consistency: jmap-mail-types is the canonical extension-types template per workspace AGENTS.md; scope and field-shape are inherited from parent epic JMAP-lbdy and apply identically to every sibling extension-types crate (chat, calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, sharing). Each in-scope struct adds one field with the documented attribute; no public types added/renamed/removed. Changes here propagate to all six siblings in the same pass.

Acceptance: every in-scope struct has `pub extra: Map<String, Value>` with the documented attributes; one round-trip preservation test per type; PLAN.md updated; cargo test --all-features / clippy / fmt clean.
title: Adopt extras policy in jmap-mail-types
